Kennel cleaning on a challenging cycle
This page helps new colleagues see why

kennel cleaning matters at Aurelia Skyways, because every animal in the Companion Animal Travel Desk system depends on a calm, safe place while travel plans move from booking through pickup. A clean kennel is more than a tidy space. It supports comfort, lowers stress, and helps the team keep a steady standard for each traveler. New staff should treat this part of desk work with the same care as paperwork and handover notes, since the two go together.

Start by checking the kennel area with a patient eye. Look for leftover bedding, loose fur, spills, and anything that could bother an animal or slow the next prep step. Work from the cleanest section toward the most used section, and keep your movements calm. Animals notice hurried behavior, and a steady routine helps them settle. When a kennel has been used by a nervous pet, give a little extra time to the space so the next arrival gets a fresh start.

Use approved cleaning supplies only, and follow the simple sequence the desk team uses every day. Remove waste, wash surfaces, dry the kennel well, and return clean bedding or liners as directed. If you see damage, a strong smell that does not clear, or signs that an animal has made a mess beyond the usual routine, tell the senior coordinator right away. Small issues are easier to manage when they are shared early.

Desk work also includes passing practical notes to the crew so the right care reaches the right animal. That can mean flagging a pet that prefers extra quiet, noting a travel bag that needs special attention, or reminding the team to keep items matched to the booking file. Every animal receives patient attention from trained staff, and your record keeping helps make that possible.

When the area is ready, give it one last look before the next handover. A good kennel clean protects comfort, supports safety, and keeps the whole desk running smoothly. Remember to clean carefully, speak up early, and keep every animal's space ready with quiet confidence.
